SHIVTEJ RAMCHANDRA GURAV Senior QA Engineer | Test Automation (Tosca) | Insurance & BFSI Domain

Pune, India | +917020693988| gurav.pavan2303@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/shivatej-gurav-854360a5

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven QA Engineer with 7+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and SDLC management within the insurance and banking domains. Expert in Tricentis Tosca automation, defect management, and Agile methodologies, with a track record of improving test coverage and reducing manual testing effort on enterprise releases. Recognized for analytical rigor, cross- functional collaboration, and delivering high-quality releases under tight deadlines.

CORE SKILLS

Test Automation

Tricentis Tosca, TBox, Classic Engine, Distributed Execution (DEX), Test Data Service (TDS)

Testing Types

Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, Integration, System, User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

Test & Defect Mgmt

JIRA, Confluence, Master Craft DevPlus, Test Control Suite

Methodologies

Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, STLC, Defect Lifecycle Management

Technical

SQL, SQL Server Management Studio

Domain Knowledge

Insurance (Life, Motor, General), Banking / BFSI

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior QA Engineer — Expleo Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. Project: Allianz Germany | Domain: Insurance

Jan 2023 – Jun 2026

Designed and maintained automated regression test suites in Tricentis Tosca across web and Windows application layers, improving test coverage by 40%.

Built and managed Tosca Reusable Test Blocks (RTBs), recovery scenarios, and complex test structures to increase script maintainability and reuse.

Executed Tosca Distributed Execution (DEX) via test event creation and registration, enabling parallel test runs across environments and reducing manual testing effort by 50%.

Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing. • Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA. • Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines. Sep 2018 – Jan 2023

Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing. • Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA. • Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines. Sep 2018 – Jan 2023

Performed manual testing across insurance sub-modules using functional, regression, system, integration, and user acceptance testing approaches.

Owned requirement analysis, test scenario/case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect reporting. • Used Master Craft DevPlus and JIRA for test management and defect tracking. • Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination. • Produced traceability matrices, test outcome reports, and daily/weekly defect reports. • Collaborated with product owners on backlog management and continuous delivery of features. Jul 2014 – Aug 2018

Owned requirement analysis, test scenario/case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect reporting. • Used Master Craft DevPlus and JIRA for test management and defect tracking. • Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination. • Produced traceability matrices, test outcome reports, and daily/weekly defect reports. • Collaborated with product owners on backlog management and continuous delivery of features. Jul 2014 – Aug 2018

Flagged and resolved system/report errors, escalating IT tickets to prevent recurrence. • Managed BaNCS application user access, including authorizations, team realignment, and account transfers. • Analyzed functional specifications and provided resolution guidance to the customer service team. • Authored configuration and workflow documentation reflecting ongoing process changes. • Represented the team in pre/post-release IT forums, flagging release impact on existing processes. • Created business permission documentation and clarified user access requirements.

Process Executive — Infosys BPO Project: BMO Overdraft | Domain: Banking

Jan 2013 – Jun 2014

Managed business and retail overdraft accounts for Bank of Montreal (US & Canada), coordinating with portfolio managers via email and calls.

Processed cross-border fund transfers between Canadian and US accounts using daily foreign exchange rates. • Delivered monthly presentations on productivity, quality, volumes, and escalations. • Trained new associates and cross-team trainees on process procedures. • Participated in financial transaction audits to maintain quality standards.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Computer Applications — Shivaji University, G.A. College, Sangli

CERTIFICATIONS

ISTQB Foundation Level • Tosca Certified: AS1, AS2, TDS1 • TCS Domain Certification — Business Analysis & Manual Testing (Insurance Specialization)

AWARDS

Received multiple “High Five” awards for contributions beyond grade level and driving increased automation adoption.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior QA Engineer — Expleo Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. Project: Allianz Germany | Domain: Insurance
Jan 2023 – Jun 2026
Designed and maintained automated regression test suites in Tricentis Tosca across web and Windows application layers, improving test coverage by 40%.
Built and managed Tosca Reusable Test Blocks (RTBs), recovery scenarios, and complex test structures to increase script maintainability and reuse.
Executed Tosca Distributed Execution (DEX) via test event creation and registration, enabling parallel test runs across environments and reducing manual testing effort by 50%.
Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing. • Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA. • Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines. Sep 2018 – Jan 2023
Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing. • Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA. • Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines. Sep 2018 – Jan 2023
Performed manual testing across insurance sub-modules using functional, regression, system, integration, and user acceptance testing approaches.
Owned requirement analysis, test scenario/case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect reporting. • Used Master Craft DevPlus and JIRA for test management and defect tracking. • Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination. • Produced traceability matrices, test outcome reports, and daily/weekly defect reports. • Collaborated with product owners on backlog management and continuous delivery of features. Jul 2014 – Aug 2018
Owned requirement analysis, test scenario/case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect reporting. • Used Master Craft DevPlus and JIRA for test management and defect tracking. • Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination. • Produced traceability matrices, test outcome reports, and daily/weekly defect reports. • Collaborated with product owners on backlog management and continuous delivery of features. Jul 2014 – Aug 2018
Flagged and resolved system/report errors, escalating IT tickets to prevent recurrence. • Managed BaNCS application user access, including authorizations, team realignment, and account transfers. • Analyzed functional specifications and provided resolution guidance to the customer service team. • Authored configuration and workflow documentation reflecting ongoing process changes. • Represented the team in pre/post-release IT forums, flagging release impact on existing processes. • Created business permission documentation and clarified user access requirements.
Process Executive — Infosys BPO Project: BMO Overdraft | Domain: Banking
Jan 2013 – Jun 2014
Managed business and retail overdraft accounts for Bank of Montreal (US & Canada), coordinating with portfolio managers via email and calls.
Processed cross-border fund transfers between Canadian and US accounts using daily foreign exchange rates. • Delivered monthly presentations on productivity, quality, volumes, and escalations. • Trained new associates and cross-team trainees on process procedures. • Participated in financial transaction audits to maintain quality standards.
